title: Kelvo worker on Oracle E2.1.Micro: pinned 6749369 capacity baseline
scope: Worker-only accounting. Azure gateway, three NATS brokers, ClickHouse source, and all SSH tunnel processes are excluded. Does not certify later runtime changes or whole-cluster micro-VM fit.

host.machine_scope: Oracle VM.Standard.E2.1.Micro: fractional CPU allocation; visible logical CPUs are not dedicated cores

conditions.transport: separate pinned-key SSH control, source and result connections
conditions.cache_state: warm and uncontrolled; independent reference preparation precedes profiles
conditions.competing_work: Other bounded Azure acceptance tests ran during this campaign; Oracle fractional CPU allocation, burst capacity and host steal vary.
conditions.metrics_interpretation: Five paired observations do not establish causal memory savings or a speedup.

harness_controls.scope: Synthetic positive/negative controls, not performance evidence.

summary.scope: One executor, three serial queries then ten concurrent queued submissions per profile. Service cgroup includes observer; source, gateway, NATS and SSH excluded. Sample p95 is nearest rank, not a confidence bound.

resources.sampling_scope: RSS: observed node and worker processes across delegated descendants. Cgroup: node, disposable children and Python observer; excludes source, gateway, NATS and SSH. Shared RSS pages can be counted twice; sampling can miss short peaks.

client.timing_scope: Submission through complete Arrow response at the Azure client; SQL, dispatch, verified TLS and Oracle-Azure SSH transport included. Value decoding is outside timing. Source/gateway/NATS/SSH resources excluded from separate Oracle node cgroup.

queued_burst.scope: Concurrent queued submissions; at most one query executes on this node at a time.

lease_expiry_observations.scope: TLS-verified read-only observation of the owned fixture worker lease; owner and credentials omitted

earlier_attempts.scope: Retained separately; excluded from five-pair statistics.
notes: Earlier WAN completion failures motivated the recorded worker lease/handoff regression fixes.
The first 2103318 enabled launch preceded the prior 30-second worker fencing lease expiry and failed closed.

A subsequent 2103318 enabled run returned all exact results but the harness initially counted the startup SELECT 1 as workload; the corrected harness records startup 1 then verifies the workload delta.

lease_fencing.enabled_node_log: worker identity is already active or its store is unavailable
lease_fencing.observation_scope: TLS-verified read-only observation of the owned fixture worker lease; the lease owner and credentials are omitted. Start and report timestamps come from the owned profile files on Oracle.
lease_fencing.conclusion: The second profile tried to claim the same worker identity before the prior worker fencing lease expired. The launch failed closed as designed. No queries ran in that failed profile. Its reports and cleanup evidence are retained.
